value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete existence-and-exact-value classification for two strengthened domination invariants on a natural zero-deleted module graph. The deletion creates a sharp algebraic boundary at |T(M)|=2 and a distinct torsion-free negation-pair regime, so the result is not a cosmetic restatement of the full-graph domination formula.
